comun.activo_hint: Type the name or the ID; the list suggests the assets on your farms.
comun.activo_requerido: Choose an asset from the list or type its ID.
comun.fecha_futura: The date cannot be in the future.
comun.mayor_que_cero: Enter a number greater than zero.
comun.rango_invalido: The end date must be on or after the start date.
comun.motivo_corto: Write at least {{min}} characters ({{faltan}} to go).
comun.sin_conexion_detalle: You can browse what is loaded; new records and voids need a connection.
comun.seguimiento_fallo: Could not check the progress. Reload the page to see whether it finished.

consumo.descripcion: Rations given to each asset. A validated record is never edited: if it is wrong, void it with a reason and record it again.
consumo.tipo_alimento_hint: ID of the feed in the supplies catalog; it must be active.
consumo.tipo_alimento_invalido: Enter the feed ID (a whole number).
consumo.vacio_detalle: Rations you record will show up here. Adjust the filters to look at a specific period.
consumo.anular_descripcion: The record stays in the history as voided and its cost is taken off the production cycle. This cannot be undone.

medicamento.descripcion: Treatments given to each asset, with their withdrawal period. A validated application is never edited: it is voided with a reason.
medicamento.costo_unitario_hint: The total cost is computed from the dose.
medicamento.retiro_hint: 0 if the medication has no withdrawal period.
medicamento.retiro_invalido: Enter a whole number of days (0 or more).
medicamento.motivo_hint: At least 10 characters; kept in the clinical trail.
medicamento.vacio_detalle: Medication applications will show up here with their withdrawal period.
medicamento.anular_descripcion: The application is marked voided, its cost is taken off the cycle and it no longer counts toward the withdrawal period. This cannot be undone.

ica.descripcion: Feed conversion ratio: kilos of feed per kilo gained. Lower is better.
ica.vacio_detalle: See its current FCR and how its previous calculations evolved.
ica.no_calculable: The FCR could not be calculated
ica.sin_resultado: This asset has no FCR for the chosen period yet.
ica.historial_vacio: No previous calculations for this period.

batch.sin_corridas: The batch has not run yet.
batch.interrumpir_descripcion: Assets already processed keep their result; pending ones stay queued for the next run.

costeo.descripcion: Direct costs accumulated in each asset's current cycle and their IAS 41 consolidation at closing.
costeo.vacio_detalle: You will see the accumulated cost of its current cycle, the supplies behind it and the IAS 41 reports.
costeo.sin_ciclo: The asset has no active production cycle
costeo.sin_registros: The cycle has no supplies yet.
costeo.solo_directos: Feed and medication come in on their own
costeo.solo_directos_detalle: They are charged to the cycle when recorded under Feeding or Medications. Veterinary services and inseminations go here.
costeo.justificacion_hint: At least 20 characters: where the price comes from (invoice, quote…).
costeo.corregir_detalle: {{descripcion}}: {{cantidad}}, {{costo}}. The correction is added as a new record and the original is kept (RF-78).

nic41.descripcion: When a cycle closes, its cost report is consolidated for Finance. Each correction creates a new version and keeps the previous ones.
nic41.solo_cerrado: Only a closed cycle can be consolidated.
nic41.sin_versiones: This cycle has no consolidated report yet.
nic41.incompleto_detalle: The amount does not match the cycle total or there are provisions not yet delivered to Finance. Review it before using it.
nic41.corregir_descripcion: The consolidation is recomputed with current data and the previous version is superseded, not deleted.

gastos.descripcion: Feeding and medication expenses over a date range, with their breakdown and the trend against the previous period.
gastos.procesando_detalle: Status: {{estado}}. It will show up here when it is done.
gastos.fallo: The report could not be generated. Try a shorter range.
gastos.sin_datos: No expenses in the chosen period.
gastos.tendencia_SIN_BASE_COMPARATIVA: No expenses in the previous period to compare against.
gastos.sin_costo_one: {{count}} record without a cost was left out
gastos.sin_costo_other: {{count}} records without a cost were left out
gastos.historial_vacio: You have not generated any reports yet.
gastos.regenerar_hint: Recompute the report with current data.

historial.vacio_detalle: The history is looked up per asset; the other filters are optional.
historial.costos_invalidos: The maximum cost must be greater than or equal to the minimum.
historial.sin_contexto: some context data (asset, cycle) is unavailable
historial.sin_resultados_detalle: Widen the date range or remove filters.

auditoria.descripcion: Immutable log of the module's operations. IAS 41 events are kept for 5 years; technical ones for 1 year.
auditoria.vacio_detalle: No audit events match those filters.
